bullets.text: Fifteen employees in Velachery are working in fear as the local wildlife division office is in danger of collapsing due to lack of renovation funds, so the office should monitor and address the safety issue.
Veteran player IM Ramanathan Balasubramaniam won the 24th Adyar Times Classical Trophy in Velachery for the sixth time following a two-way tie, showcasing local chess excellence.
An individual in Thiruttani opposed releasing surplus water from the Jothi Nagar lake amidst two days of continuous rain, requiring local authorities to manage the situation safely.
Visakhapatnam is showing clear signs of transformation in its IT space with new anchoring investments that validate the city's talent, prompting the office to track regional tech growth.
Prof Thillai Rajan highlighted that Indian startup innovations capture global attention despite the ecosystem suffering from a lack of reliable and accessible data.
An MoU focusing on research in emerging technologies was exchanged in the presence of Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister D. K. Shivakumar.

takeaways: IM Ramanathan Balasubramaniam won the 24th Adyar Times Classical Trophy in Adyar for the sixth time.
